title: Reply: it is never obvious what causes what

statements.text: It is never obvious what causes what. Falling barometers are regularly followed by storms but do not cause them. If one brain event causes both a mental event and the next brain event, every such mental event is followed by that brain event, and the counterfactual that without the mental event the action would not have occurred can hold, though the mental event causes nothing.

sources.quote: First, it can never be obvious what causes what.
the holding of counterfactuals is not enough to show causation
